Heart transplant example data

Source: R/exampleData.R
loadAmancherla.Rd

Downloads the Amancherla et al. (2025) heart transplant Xenium dataset from the SpatialDatasets package (via ExperimentHub) and prepares it for fuzzyCell: renames the columns fuzzyCell expects, keeps patients with cellular rejection, and keeps one randomly chosen image per patient for each biopsy timing. The first call downloads the data, which is large. With "both" every patient has an image before and after transplant, so those images are not independent and cannot be passed together to runColocalisationModels() with subject = "subject".

Usage

loadAmancherla(timing = c("pre", "post", "both"), seed = 51773)

Arguments

timing

Which biopsies to keep: "pre" or "post" transplant, or "both".

seed

Random seed used to choose one image per patient.

Value

A SpatialExperiment.

Details

The prepared object has the columns fuzzyCell functions use: cellID, imageID, cellType, x, y and subject, and the per-patient outcome resolution_broad ("persistence" or "resolved"). The cell type hierarchy for these cell types is in heartCellTypeTree.

Examples

# \donttest{
spe = loadAmancherla("pre")
